messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: HealthTech Procurement <procurement@healthtech.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: HealthTech — activation checklist & MSA redline alignment

Hi team,

Thanks again for the productive discovery call last week. Per our notes, I’ve attached the redline copy of the Redwood MSA and a draft order form that reflects the initial committed usage. Two quick items we need to resolve to complete vendor activation in your procurement system (Ariba/Coupa):

- Confirm vendor legal name and remit-to address exactly as registered in Ariba (we've seen mismatches block PO issuance).
- Agree on final MSA redline items: liability cap language (section 9), data residency appendix, and the deletion retention term in section 12.
- Confirm PO routing attributes: can you confirm whether you require a vendor tax ID and PO line-item code for software subscriptions? We included a proposed field mapping CSV attached.

I’ve looped in Dev (ops) to coordinate the portal fields and Lauren from Legal for the redline questions. Can you please: 1) confirm the vendor ID to use in Ariba, and 2) indicate whether HealthTech prefers to accept the doc we attached or provide their version for redline?

If helpful, we can do a quick 20–30 minute call tomorrow to walk the MSA items and the Ariba field mapping.

Attachments: HealthTech-MSA-redline-20261101.docx, OrderForm_HealthTech_v1.pdf, ariba_field_mapping_proposal.csv

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Amelia Rivera <amelia.rivera@healthtech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, HealthTech Procurement <procurement@healthtech.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HealthTech — activation checklist & MSA redline alignment

Marissa / team,

Thanks for the packet. A few quick notes from Legal (high level):

- Liability cap: HealthTech policy prefers a 1x annual fee cap for SaaS vendors; we can be flexible if we see compensating language on indemnities and breach response SLA.
- Data residency: we will need a written statement about data residency options and export controls; if Redwood can commit to US-only residency for our tenant please flag it in the order form.
- Deletion/retention: we require a 30-day purge window post-termination unless otherwise agreed.

We can accept your redline as a starting point but will likely send our tracked changes. Please have your legal contact reach out to me directly (I’m cc’ing procurement).

Also, procurement note: we will need the vendor tax ID and a primary contact for invoice escalation in the vendor record.

–Amelia
General Counsel (acting)
HealthTech
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Rivera <amelia.rivera@healthtech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HealthTech — activation checklist & MSA redline alignment

Amelia / Marissa —

Thanks, Amelia, that is helpful and aligns with what I expected. Quick summary from my side so we can narrow to the three toggles that will unblock procurement: 

1) Liability cap: we can agree to a 1x annual fee cap where the order form fee is the baseline, but we will ask for an exception to preserve our ability to seek equitable relief for IP infringement claims. A short carve-out sentence should be acceptable.

2) Data residency: Redwood offers a US-only tenant for regulated customers; I will add the explicit clause to the order form and provide the technical control list. Please confirm that \"US-only\" satisfies HealthTech's requirement or if you need a specific region/region+state notation.

3) Retention/deletion: We can commit to a 30-day purge window; will propose an addendum that allows 90 days for archived logs with customer approval.

Action items for HealthTech to unblock vendor activation in Ariba/Coupa: vendor tax ID, remit address, invoice contact email, and preferred vendor ID string. Once we have those four items we will push the order form + final MSA for signature (DocuSign link included below).

I’ve attached a one-page legal summary for internal review: Legal_Summary_HT_onboarding_20261109.pdf

Lauren Bishop
Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
